description: Bake cookies, pizza, pastries, and more with this Aurora True Jelly Roll Pan by Chicago Metallic. Made from heavy-weight carbon steel for superior heat conduction and even baking, this strong and durable pan features a rolled rim to prevent warping, and a nonstick coating for easy release and cleanup. Exclusive to Chicago Metallic, the iridescent finish of Aurora Bakeware has a unique and trendy shimmer and color-changing effect, making each piece as beautiful as it is essential for bakers. Measures 1-inch tall with 15-1/2 x 10-1/2 exterior diameter and a 15 x 10 interior. Hand-wash with warm water and a mild detergent; rinse and dry immediately.
